text:
sam: Heads-up — noticed a routing drift for private endpoints: TLS offload at edge strips X-Workspace header, and our router is ejecting to hosted pools.
claire: saw a spike in route.fallback yesterday, matches latency alerts. requests from private customers ended up in hosted capacity.
ajay: is the edge doing TLS offload or passthrough? offload will drop client headers unless configured.
sam: edge is offloading. original request had `X-Workspace: ws_123` but backend saw none. our matching rule is header-first and ejected the pool.
sophia: we should prefer header-preserve for private endpoints. gateway should forward headers when destination is a private pool. e.g.

```
# gateway config snippet
route {
  match {
    header: X-Workspace
  }
  preserve_headers: ["X-Workspace"]
  private_pool: true
}
```

infra-bot: deploy: canary started for gateway-config v2.3.4 — 10% -> 20% :rocket:
claire: also recommend a telemetry counter `route.header_missing` with labels (workspace, pool, src_edge) so we can see where headers are dropped.
ajay: also consider changing ejection policy: instead of immediate eject on missing header, use a probation window (e.g., 3 misses within 60s) before demoting to fallback.
devex: from console UX side, surface the exact fallback reason on route detail (header_missing / pool_unavailable) and last-seen X-Workspace in the request timeline so teams can debug quickly.
sophia: note: for TLS offload we need to preserve SNI and forward `X-Workspace`. if passthrough isn't possible, fall back to client_ip->workspace mapping before ejection.
sam: Plan: revert aggressive ejection for missing header, add the `route.header_missing` metric, update gateway config to preserve header for private pools, and canary deploy. I'll open a PR for the config change and tests.
ajay: sgtm. please add unit tests for the matcher and an integration test simulating TLS offload.
infra-bot: CI: gateway-config tests passed on canary v2.3.4; integration suite had 1 flaky case — rerunning.
sam: thanks. @claire can you add a Grafana panel for `route.header_missing` (24h view) and a link from route details to the logs?
claire: :thumbsup: on it, will add alert if rate > 0.1% of requests for a workspace.
sam: tagging @devex — after metrics + UX we should email SRE and support so they can triage impacted customers while we finish the rollout.
devex: noted, will draft a short playbook entry explaining header-drop symptoms and mitigation steps.
